related.title: Elastic ECS：事件時間、型別與正規化契約
related.titleEn: Elastic ECS: event time, types and normalization contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：30與60秒不含額外開銷，正常與異常變更皆可見；未先抹除舊基準再調查。 交付檔案基準清單、三類事件與核准/未核准變更處置表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: State that 30 and 60 seconds exclude extra overhead, keep approved/unapproved changes visible and preserve the old baseline for analysis. Deliver baseline inventory, three event classes and approved/unapproved disposition table.
related.difference: 把合成原始時間、收集時間與索引時間映射到明確欄位；逐一指定時區、秒/毫秒與IP/port型別，保留原始資料來源。
related.differenceEn: Map synthetic occurrence, collection and indexing times to explicit fields; define timezone, seconds/milliseconds and IP/port types while retaining raw provenance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 順序讀取的理想掃描時間=總資料MiB/有效吞吐MiB每秒；metadata、雜湊CPU與小檔案開銷另算，雜湊變更不直接證明惡意。 2100個教學檔案各1MiB，假設有效掃描70MiB/秒。 2100/70=30秒；吞吐降至35MiB/秒時需60秒。
管線延遲=ingest_time−event_time，僅在兩端時鐘可比較時有意義；正規化不能把發生時間覆寫成收到時間。 同一時基下事件時間100000毫秒、索引時間100350毫秒；時間戳均已轉成整數毫秒。 100350−100000=350毫秒；索引時間改100900時延遲900毫秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal sequential scan time is total MiB divided by effective MiB/s; metadata, hashing CPU and small-file overhead are separate, and a hash change alone does not prove malice. There are 2100 teaching files of 1 MiB each, with assumed effective scanning throughput 70 MiB/s. 2100/70=30 seconds; throughput 35 MiB/s needs 60 seconds.

Pipeline latency is ingest_time−event_time and requires comparable clocks; normalization must not overwrite occurrence time with arrival time. On one time basis, event time is 100000 ms and ingest time 100350 ms; both timestamps are normalized integer milliseconds. 100350−100000=350 ms; ingest time 100900 yields 900 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Windows LAPS：每機密碼、輪替與取用稽核
related.titleEn: Windows LAPS: per-device passwords, rotation and retrieval audit
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：30與60秒不含額外開銷，正常與異常變更皆可見；未先抹除舊基準再調查。 交付檔案基準清單、三類事件與核准/未核准變更處置表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: State that 30 and 60 seconds exclude extra overhead, keep approved/unapproved changes visible and preserve the old baseline for analysis. Deliver baseline inventory, three event classes and approved/unapproved disposition table.
related.difference: 用虛構裝置ID建立每機獨立密碼的中繼資料清單；只記輪替時間、備份狀態與取用稽核，絕不把密碼本體放入課程表。
related.differenceEn: Inventory per-device password metadata using fictional IDs; record rotation time, backup status and retrieval audit without placing passwords in course data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 順序讀取的理想掃描時間=總資料MiB/有效吞吐MiB每秒；metadata、雜湊CPU與小檔案開銷另算，雜湊變更不直接證明惡意。 2100個教學檔案各1MiB，假設有效掃描70MiB/秒。 2100/70=30秒；吞吐降至35MiB/秒時需60秒。
均勻分散排程的平均每日輪替量=裝置數/週期日數；峰值、離線裝置與重試另算，輪替成功不代表備份可取用。 教學300台裝置、30日輪替週期，排程均勻且無離線。 300/30=10次輪替/日；週期改15日後300/15=20次/日。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal sequential scan time is total MiB divided by effective MiB/s; metadata, hashing CPU and small-file overhead are separate, and a hash change alone does not prove malice. There are 2100 teaching files of 1 MiB each, with assumed effective scanning throughput 70 MiB/s. 2100/70=30 seconds; throughput 35 MiB/s needs 60 seconds.

With evenly spread scheduling, average daily rotations=devices/period days; peaks, offline devices and retries are separate, and rotation success does not prove retrievable backup. A teaching fleet has 300 devices on a 30-day evenly spread rotation cycle, with no offline devices. 300/30=10 rotations/day; a 15-day cycle gives 20/day.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
